description_capsule: A space capsule is a habitable spacecraft that uses a blunt-body capsule to re-enter Earth's atmosphere without wings. Our capsule is where you will spend your time during the flight. It includes a gym, a cinema, and many other activities to entertain you.
description_commandant: Douglas Gerald Hurley is an American engineer, a former Marine Corps pilot, and a former NASA astronaut. He ventured into space for the third time as the commander of the Crew Dragon Demo-2 spacecraft.
description_europe: The smallest of the four Galilean moons orbiting Jupiter, Europe is a winter lover's dream. Its icy surface is perfect for ice skating, curling, hockey, or simply relaxing in your cozy winter cabin.
description_ingenieure: Anousheh Ansari is an Iranian-American engineer and co-founder of Prodea Systems. Ansari was the fourth self-funded space tourist, the first self-funded woman to visit the ISS, and the first Iranian in space.
description_lanceur: A launcher or carrier rocket is a rocket-powered vehicle used to transport a payload from the Earth's surface to space, usually to Earth orbit or beyond. Our WEB-X rocket is the most powerful in service. Standing at 150 meters tall, it provides an impressive spectacle on the launch pad!
description_lune: See our planet like you've never seen it before. A perfect relaxing journey to help you step back and come back rejuvenated. While you're there, immerse yourself in history by visiting the landing sites of Luna 2 and Apollo 11.
description_mars: Don't forget your hiking boots. You'll need them to climb Mount Olympus, the tallest planetary mountain in our solar system. It's two and a half times the size of Everest!
description_pilote: Pilot of the first operational flight of the SpaceX Crew Dragon to the International Space Station. Glover is a commander in the U.S. Navy, where he pilots an F/A-18. He was a crew member of Expedition 64 and served as a systems flight engineer.
description_spatioport: A spaceport or cosmodrome is a launch (or receiving) site for spacecraft, analogous to a seaport for ships or an airport for aircraft. Based at the famous Cape Canaveral, our spaceport is ideally located to take advantage of Earth's rotation for launch.
description_specialiste: Mark Richard Shuttleworth is the founder and CEO of Canonical, the company behind the Ubuntu Linux-based operating system. Shuttleworth became the first South African to travel to space as a space tourist.
description_titan: The only moon known to have a dense atmosphere other than Earth, Titan is like a home away from home (just a few hundred degrees colder!). As a bonus, you can enjoy stunning views of Saturn's rings.
